translation_snapshot.source: Reach out and touch the blood and health of your foes. Any creatures caught in the radius 2 ball will be unable to heal above their current life value (at the time of the casting) for %d turns.
translation_snapshot.target: 掌控敌人的血液和肉体。在 2 码范围内，任何被鲜血禁锢攻击到的敌人的治疗或回复将不能超过当前生命值，持续 %d 回合。
